blocks.text: Nighttime viewing at Jeju Island’s Cheonjiyeon Falls has been temporarily suspended following the death of a man who fell into the water while taking photos. On Saturday, shortly after 8:30 p.m., a tourist in his 50s fell about 2 meters into the water while taking photos. Other tourists reportedly threw a life ring after the accident, but were unable to save him. Firefighters pulled him from the water about 10 minutes later. He was in cardiac arrest and was taken to a nearby hospital, where he was pronounced dead. READ: From romantic getaway to hotbed of crime? Rumor mill fans Jeju […]...
